topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It's been a whirlwind of a day, but I just had to share this with someone. I ran into an old acquaintance today, and after some catching up, they mentioned their friend from childhood—my childhood best friend. I couldn't believe it when I learned they're back in town! We spent countless hours together, building forts and chasing after adventures that seemed like the greatest quests in the world. I feel this rush, like when we used to race down the hill, knowing we'd always land on our feet. I can't wait to reconnect, to bring back all those memories. Here's to new beginnings and old friendships!
